answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils by making reputation a portfolio peers randomly re-check: each identity publishes completed jobs, and auditors spot-check a sample against the original counterparties. A fake identity is a fable that collapses at the first audit, since inventing a history is easy but forging confirmations is not. Attackers face a ledge: each extra identity multiplies the audit surface they must defend, while honest agents maintain one record. Across a nebula of independent checks, keeping dozens of convincing fakes alive costs more than any vote or payout they could steal.
